quotes.text: When faith takes root in the quiet unseen places of the heart, no gale of circumstance can uproot your purpose.
Healing does not mean the fracture never occurred; it means the scar has become a vessel of compassion for others.
Wisdom is not knowing every answer; it is having the courage to sit in reverence before truth you cannot yet explain.
Hope is the anchor cast into tomorrow that steadies the ship in the tempest of today.
Courage is rarely loud. Most often, courage is the quiet voice at evening whispers: I will begin again with the dawn.
Truth needs no armor other than its own endurance; false things shatter under the gentle weight of time.
Your purpose is not a trophy to be won, but a garden entrusted to your patient hands.
In the stillness where self-importance dissolves, the whisper of genuine understanding begins.

author.name: Sky
author.tagline: Author, Philosopher & Founder of Heartwoven Wonders
author.introduction: Sky is an author, thinker, and contemplative writer dedicated to creating literature that pierces through distraction and anchors the human spirit in faith, interior healing, and enduring purpose.
author.biography: For more than two decades, Sky has observed the quiet spiritual hunger beneath modern life—the exhaustion of endless noise and the yearning for authentic healing. Heartwoven Wonders was founded not merely as an imprint, but as a worldwide sanctuary where words become living medicine, guiding seekers through emotional renewal and faith-rooted clarity.
author.philosophy: We believe a book should not merely entertain the intellect; it should companion the soul. True publishing is an act of sacred stewardship: delivering truth with unsparing beauty, deep empathy, and uncompromising craftsmanship.
author.purposeMessage: Our purpose is to ensure that wherever you are in the world—whether sitting in solitude during grief or standing at the crossroads of your destiny—you hold in your hands words woven with care, truth, and unshakable light.

policies.title: About Heartwoven Wonders Publishing House
policies.content: Heartwoven Wonders is an independent worldwide digital publishing house and online bookstore founded by author Sky. We create literature that pierces through distraction and anchors the human spirit in faith, interior healing, and enduring purpose. Our publications encompass adult nonfiction, philosophical contemplation, mental wellness, and spiritual growth.

policies.title: Digital Delivery & Download Policy
policies.content: All books and audiobooks purchased on Heartwoven Wonders are delivered digitally and instantly worldwide. Upon successful PayPal checkout, orders are immediately confirmed and linked to your private My Library account. You may choose between PDF, EPUB, and Audiobook editions where available.

policies.title: Refund & Satisfaction Guarantee
policies.content: We stand completely behind the spiritual and literary integrity of our works. Because digital deliverables are provided immediately upon checkout, we offer a 14-day compassionate refund guarantee if you encounter technical difficulty accessing your files or if the work did not match its stated description.

policies.title: Privacy Policy & Data Protection
policies.content: Heartwoven Wonders respects the sanctity of your private information. We never sell, rent, or trade customer emails or purchase records. Customer accounts are used exclusively for digital library access, purchase verification, and optional publishing notices.

policies.title: Terms of Service
policies.content: By purchasing from Heartwoven Wonders, you receive a personal, non-transferable license to read, listen, and contemplate our works across your personal devices. Commercial reproduction or unauthorized redistribution of our manuscripts and audiobooks is strictly prohibited.

policies.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
policies.content:
Q: How do I read EPUB files?
A: EPUB is an open standard readable on Apple Books, Kobo, Kindle, and Thorium Reader.

Q: Are the audiobooks generated with real voices?
A: Yes! Our audiobooks feature authentic spoken narration produced chapter-by-chapter with measured cadence.

Q: Can I pay with PayPal from anywhere?
A: Yes, PayPal supports worldwide payments in standard international currencies.
